name: compare
title: Compare
description: Two pictures of the same thing, and a handle that draws the line between them.
use: Two pictures of the same framing that a reader compares by moving a line: before and after an edit, light and dark, a draft and its revision.

instead.when: There is one picture, with or without a caption
The handle sets a value and no pictures are compared
There are more than two pictures, seen one after another

keyboard.action: Move the line by a step, as the native range input does

platform.feature: Scroll-driven animations: view-timeline on the thumb of the input and timeline-scope on the frame
platform.fallback: The script copies the input's value into --compare-position. Without the script the handle moves and the pictures stay parted where --compare-position puts them

classes.name: compare
classes.description: The frame: it stacks the two pictures, draws the line and takes a surface's corner

classes.name: compare-before
classes.description: The picture underneath, shown from the start to the line

classes.name: compare-after
classes.description: The picture on top, clipped at the line and shown from the line to the end

classes.name: compare-range
classes.description: The handle: a range input across the frame with no track and a grip for a thumb. Name it for what moving it does

properties.name: --compare-position
properties.description: Where the line stands, from the start, as a percentage. It is registered with an initial value of 50%; the stylesheet or the script sets it from the handle

properties.name: --compare-radius
properties.description: Corner of the frame; lower it to nest the frame in a card

properties.name: --compare-grip
properties.description: Size of the grip; 2.75rem on a coarse pointer
